outcome: cord blood B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP) levels
cord blood prohormone of BNP (amnio terminal segment) levels
fetal tricuspid annular plane systolic excursion
fetal mitral annular plane systolic excursion
cohort: The study included 78 fetuses/infants from uncomplicated pregnancies and 32 fetuses/infants from pregnancies complicated by maternal pre-gestational or gestational diabetes.
finding: Infants of diabetic and obese mothers exhibit elevated biochemical markers of cardiac dysfunction (BNP) in cord blood, which correlate with increased interventricular septum thickness.
